name: Wall Slide
steps: Stand with your back against a wall, knees soft and feet slightly forward.
Raise your arms into a goalpost W position with the backs of your elbows, forearms, and hands resting against the wall.
Slide your arms slowly upward overhead into a Y shape while keeping your ribs down and maintaining contact between your wrists, elbows, and the wall.
Glide your arms smoothly back down to the starting W position, continuing steadily for the target duration.
tips: Stop sliding upward as soon as your lower back begins to arch off the wall or your wrists peel away.
Let your shoulder blades rotate upward as your arms rise, keeping your neck relaxed.
